name: us-municipal-bulk-trash-and-landfill-fees-2026
title: US Municipal Curbside Bulk Trash, County Landfill Tipping Fees & Roll-Off Dumpster Street Permit Dataset (2026)
description: Primary-source verified dataset of municipal curbside bulky-waste collection rules, county landfill and transfer station commercial/residential tipping fees ($/ton), 10-40 yard roll-off dumpster rental rate ranges, and municipal street right-of-way (ROW) permit requirements across 14 US cities in 6 states (TX, FL, GA, CO, AZ, NC). Compiled and maintained by JunkHaul HQ (https://junkhaulhq.com/).
